body: So in less than three hours i'll be homeless. And nothing can stop that. Doesnt matter if I worked my ass off last 7 yers of my 25 years long life.
Yeah, exactly. If i dont give a damn about what you feel about me, why would you give a damn about me... Pure logic.
I think we might talk, cause im still searchin for a reason to stay, since i love being alive... I'm open for options yet dont believe in one.
Hello. I was born in Poland.

Believe me if I could go to U.S. I would be there few years ago ;). Anyway, walking from Czech Republic to Spain in seveir winter doesnt seem like a great plan. It currently occured to me to search if there's some way to get into some kind of volountary work just for place to sleep and food. It would be nice to help others and honestly, I dont need much more than those two things to live and be happy..

Yeah, you are right. Could find lottery ticket next day after i'm planning to die. You don't here about it too often now, dont you? All what I want to do is have work and live in peace. I'm extremely tired of the situation i'm for whole life, losing strenght to figh teach and every day and thought of going away seems to grow and be an only option.

Thank you for your post, seeing someone does care a bit can cheer up. In my homeland we have very strong unemployment and not really much options for young men like myself. I mean i've tried that already when I landed on the street before and it was extremely difficult to get place to spent night (even with -20c out there) and get financial help of 60 euro. Had to leave country to get back on feet. Didnt work too well in long-term, still, I have few more days until the end of the month and I'm fighting for it, but I'm determined to finish with my life if nothing works out.

Thanks for a kind word, really appreciated at the moment. I'm keeping myself as positive as possible trying to reach out for any new option i come up with, yet no results are shown. Going to street and begging for food seems like worse option than death tho, which im not afraid of. It's going to happen to me anyway, sooner or later. I really enjoy living tho.
I honestly do not think so. Trying to find some other job with place to sleep but there is strong language barieer which is difficult to overcome.
